landing.title: See how AI agents work together
landing.intro: Watch a real recorded run, step by step. Use the slow-down and step buttons to follow every message.
landing.body:
## What you just watched

An **agent** is a language model with a role, a goal and tools. It works in a loop: it reads what it knows, decides what to do next, uses a tool if it needs one, and repeats until it is done.

**Orchestration** decides who works when, what each agent sees, and when to stop. In this run the agents work one after another, a *sequential chain*: each agent passes its result to the next.

Click any step to read the exact message that was sent. Every number comes from the original run, and watching costs nothing.

## Where to go next

- Read the [Learn](#/learn) articles on each concept.
- See [Help](#/help) for how the player works.
- Read more [about the project](#/about).

help.title: Help
help.body:
## Using the replay

- **Play and pause** start and stop the replay. It starts on its own.
- **Speed** slows the replay down or speeds it up. Slower is easier to follow.
- **Previous step and Next step** move one message at a time.
- **The bar** lets you jump to any point.
- **Click a step** in the list to read its exact message.

## Language

Use the language buttons at the top to switch between English and Czech. Your choice is remembered in your browser. Articles that are not translated yet are shown in English.

## Good to know

The replay does not call any AI service, so watching is free. Agent Atlas stores nothing about you except the language you choose.
about.title: About Agent Atlas
about.body:
Agent Atlas is a free educational project that teaches how AI agents work, communicate and are orchestrated.

## Educational use only

Agent Atlas is a learning tool. It is not meant for real work.
